regime.GIL: Actual disabled GIL asserted at SQL thread boundaries; strict backend isolation unchanged
regime.snapshot: Lazy once/native transaction export on foreground; private job import. Export/import/setup SQL retained in measured all-role totals.
regime.pool: Persistent process-global threads only; fresh server/workflow, separate per-job DB contexts. Actual noncreating prebusiness state labels cold/warm; no forced reset/prewarm.
regime.warmup: One separate fresh excluded workflow per fixture/policy; it does not warm the next measured-process pool.
regime.SQL: Unchanged lexical data/control/TOTAL; independent source-bound setup/path/payload/business-purpose decomposition. Foreground/background and late calls retained.
regime.HTTP: Instrumented response-body wall; explicit after-response Future drain separate; no pool-thread joins or native-close intervention.
regime.statistics: ANALYZE anchors+graph_types after setup/views before first primary/reset; WAL32/64MB and no SQL statement logging.
regime.summaries: n5 full vectors, median and range; no p95 claim, no historic sample pooling

formal_release.contract: Main stage-specific authorized:true/exactplan/correctness_index. Entire selected fresh correctness complete/passed/sourceafter; actual stage budget before primary. No automatic next-stage launch.

comparison: Fresh stage timings only. No historical timing/correctness pooling. All26 fixed across A1/A2/B1/B2 with independent per-stage correctness/releases.
mechanism: All selected apps retained, including unknown/unsupported/zero-opportunity/slow outcomes; actual SQL/job/counter observations only.
SQL_preservation: SQL/originalSQL text, fingerprints, request/role/backend and protocol/frame metadata retained. Original Bind values/raw frontend packets NOT retained.
execution_controller: Frozen v1 controller with explicit v2 independent-replay binding; all Trial/observer/oracle/runtime calls unchanged.
